Error: CosyVoice TTS Pipeline Status:
├── speech_llm.onnx:     ❌ Not wired (auto-regressive LLM generates codec tokens from text)
├── flow.decoder:        ✅ Available (acoustic flow-matching, needs LLM output as input)
├── hift vocoder:        ✅ Available (mel-to-waveform conversion)
├── campplus.onnx:       ✅ Available (speaker embedding for zero-shot cloning)

(codec tokens / acoustic features). Without the LLM stage, the flow decoder 
has no meaningful input and produces noise.
